Q: jOOQ: Is it ok to create DSLContext per HTTP request? A:

jOOQ's DSLContext just wraps a Configuration, nothing more. The Configuration itself just wraps other lifecycle objects, including your database connection (which you provide to jOOQ!). So, I'm not sure why you're worried about such resource allocation when working with DSLContext instances.

Re-using the Configuration does have benefits, though, including being able to share reflection caches, and other objects, among requests / sessions.

For more information, see: https://www.jooq.org/doc/latest/manual/sql-building/dsl-context/
